response.sql: WITH pr AS (SELECT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), x AS (SELECT arcregistry, fundflux, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY fundflux) AS avg_ratio FROM pr) SELECT arcregistry AS project_id, fundflux AS funding_source, ratio, ratio - avg_ratio AS margin FROM x ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A project can have several spatial records, so its X-to-Z ratio is the mean of the per-record boxx/boxz ratios. Records with a missing boxx or boxz, or with boxz = 0, are ignored.

The funding-source benchmark is the unweighted average of the project-level ratios within the same fundflux. Projects with a NULL ratio are excluded from it, and projects with a NULL fundflux are grouped together as one group.
Margin = project ratio minus its funding-source average. Only projects with at least one matching spatial record appear.

alternatives.interpretation: Project ratio is the ratio of totals, SUM(boxx)/SUM(boxz), over records where both values are present, rather than the mean of per-record ratios.
alternatives.sql: WITH pr AS (SELECT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux, SUM(s.boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), x AS (SELECT arcregistry, fundflux, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY fundflux) AS avg_ratio FROM pr) SELECT arcregistry AS project_id, fundflux AS funding_source, ratio, ratio - avg_ratio AS margin FROM x ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
